Mayor faces scrutiny over borrowing and market concerns

Mayor Andy Burnham is facing scrutiny over his administration's borrowing plans amid market turmoil. While refusing to rule out further borrowing, Burnham's administration is reportedly grappling with rising borrowing costs, which are described as his biggest challenge. The specific details of the borrowing plans and the extent of the market turmoil's impact remain a focus of discussion.
